desc: Reduce the problem to checking whether some target sum S >= maxKnown has at least L = max(0, nA+nB-N) disjoint known-known pairs.
Implement complete Python solution with frequency counters, L=0/L=1 shortcuts, and O(UA*UB) candidate-sum accumulation using min counts.
Choose/verify a memory-safe accumulation strategy (dictionary with early exit or sorted encoded pair weights) for up to ~4 million distinct value pairs.
Test samples and edge cases: all -1, L=1, heavy duplicates, maxKnown filtering, and no valid sum.
